title: 第24章 你看你爹呢
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
又是十天后。

    大墟世界，夜。

    苍白的月光穿过雾层，洒在一条破败的街巷中。

    两侧的民房早已坍塌了大半，碎砖断瓦堆满路面，空气中弥漫着潮湿的腐味。

    陈峰站在街巷中央，握着斩刀。

    而在他身前七八米远的位置，一头黑色的巨狗正弓着脊背，发出低沉的咆哮。

    说是狗，其实已经和狗没什么关系了。

    那东西站起来足有一米五高，四肢粗壮，全身的肌肉一块一块鼓起，皮毛下面的筋络清晰可见。

    两颗獠牙从嘴角外翻，足有成人小臂长短，泛着冰冷的白光。

    嘴角不断有涎液滴落，砸在地面上，腐蚀出细微的嗤嗤声。

    面板上的文字已经浮现出来。

    【獠牙黑犬】

    【描述：成年异种野兽，具备极强的爆发力与撕咬能力，擅长短距离爆发冲刺。】

    陈峰目光扫过面板上的文字，脑海中回忆起之前看过的资料。

    这种生物，属于灵脊兽门，裂齿纲，犬形目的物种。

    成年个体，具备极强的爆发力与撕咬能力，实力高于铁鄂灰蜚，低于猎影蛛，普通淬体中期武者不是对手。

    这段时间，他在大墟世界修行，碰到的基本都是铁鄂灰蜚，倒是难得看到新物种……

    獠牙黑犬没有给他更多思考的时间。

    “嗷呜——”

    一声低吼炸开，黑犬后腿猛蹬地面，整个身躯弹射而出，速度快得惊人，转瞬间便冲到面前！

    獠牙张开，带着腐臭的气息直扑陈峰咽喉。

    陈峰没有后退。

    身体微沉，腰胯一拧，脊椎传导发力，右手斩刀顺势递出。

    蛇咬。

    刀尖精准刺入黑犬扑来的前肢根部关节。

    “噗！”

    刀锋破开皮毛，切断筋腱。

    黑犬吃痛，身体在半空中一偏，扑击的轨迹当即歪了。

    但这东西反应极快，落地的瞬间三条腿撑住身躯，嘴一歪，獠牙横扫过来。

    陈峰上身后仰，獠牙擦着他的防护服表面划过。

    下一瞬，他右脚上前半步，整个人贴了上去。

    蛇绞。

    左手空出，扣住黑犬的下颌，往外一拧。

    黑犬的脑袋被迫偏转，獠牙刺向了空处。

    与此同时，右手斩刀已经绕到了黑犬的另一条前肢。

    一割。

    又一条腿废了。

    黑犬惨嚎一声，前半截身体直接塌了下去，趴在地上。

    陈峰没有停。

    脚步绕到侧面，刀光连闪。

    两刀，两条后腿的膝关节被齐齐斩断。

    獠牙黑犬四肢尽废，庞大的身躯轰然倒地，只剩下脑袋还在疯狂扭动，獠牙在空气中胡乱撕咬，发出凄厉的嘶嚎。

    陈峰绕到正面，避开獠牙的攻击范围，刀尖对准黑犬的后脑根部。

    一刀捅进去！

    嚎叫戛然而止。

    獠牙黑犬的身躯剧烈抽搐了几下，彻底不动了。

    从黑犬发起攻击，到被彻底击杀，前后不超过五秒。

    陈峰拔出斩刀，甩掉刀身上的血液。

    呼吸平稳，心跳正常，就和没事人一样。

    这段时间，他天天在大墟世界实战训练，所杀的虫子数量怕是能堆成小山这么高。

    他已然适应了这种高强度的战斗。

    别的不谈，单说战斗搏杀时的心理素质，便已经远超常人。

    这时。

    就在刚才这一战结束后的瞬间。

    一种曾经熟悉的感觉再次从心口涌起。

    大量的画面和感受在脑海中炸开。

    过去十天的每一次战斗，每一次出刀，每一次闪避，全部被拆解成清晰的片段，在意识中高速回放。
content_en:
Ten days later again.

Daxu World, night.

The pale moonlight penetrated the fog layer and shone on a dilapidated street.

Most of the houses on both sides have collapsed, broken bricks and tiles are piled on the road, and the air is filled with a damp and rotten smell.

Chen Feng stood in the middle of the street, holding a chopping knife.

And seven or eight meters in front of him, a giant black dog was arching its back and letting out a low growl.

It is said to be a dog, but in fact it has nothing to do with dogs.

The thing stood about one and a half meters tall, with thick limbs and bulging muscles all over its body, and the veins under its fur were clearly visible.

Two fangs protruded from the corners of the mouth, as long as an adult's forearm, glowing with a cold white light.

Saliva kept dripping from the corner of his mouth, hitting the ground and making a slight hissing sound.

The text on the panel has emerged.

【tusked black dog】

[Description: An adult alien beast with extremely strong explosive power and biting ability, and is good at short-distance explosive sprints.】

Chen Feng glanced at the text on the panel and recalled the information he had read before in his mind.

This creature belongs to the phylum Linospinata, the class Schistodontida, and the order Caniformes.

Adult individuals have extremely strong explosive power and biting ability. Their strength is higher than that of Iron Jaw Gray Flies and lower than that of Shadow Hunting Spiders. They are no match for ordinary warriors in the middle stage of body tempering.

During this period of time, he was practicing in the Great Ruins world, and all he encountered were basically iron-jawed gray worms, but it was rare to see new species...

The fanged black dog didn't give him any more time to think.

"Ouch——"

With a low roar and an explosion, the black dog kicked the ground with its hind legs, and his entire body was ejected. The speed was astonishingly fast, and he rushed in front of him in an instant!

The fangs opened, and the putrid breath hit Chen Feng's throat.

Chen Feng did not retreat.

The body sank slightly, the waist and hips were twisted, the force was transmitted from the spine, and the chopping knife in the right hand was extended smoothly.

Snake bite.

The tip of the knife accurately penetrated the joint at the base of the black dog's forelimb.

"Poof!"

The blade split the fur and severed the tendons.

The black dog was in pain, its body tilted in mid-air, and the trajectory of its attack immediately became crooked.

But this thing reacted very quickly. The moment it landed, it propped up its body with three legs, tilted its mouth, and swept over with its fangs.

Chen Feng leaned back, his fangs grazing the surface of his protective suit.

The next moment, he took a half step forward with his right foot and pressed his whole body against it.

Snake twist.

With his left hand free, he grabbed the black dog's jaw and twisted it outward.

The black dog's head was forced to turn, and its fangs stabbed into the air.

At the same time, the slashing knife in his right hand had already reached the other forelimb of the black dog.

One cut.

Another leg is gone.

The black dog howled miserably, and the front half of his body collapsed, lying on the ground.

Chen Feng didn't stop.

The steps went around to the side, and the sword flashed.

With two knives, the knee joints of both hind legs were cut off.

The fanged black dog's limbs were lost, and its huge body crashed to the ground. Only its head was still twisting wildly, its fangs biting randomly in the air, and it let out a shrill howl.

Chen Feng walked around to the front, avoiding the attack range of the fangs, and aimed the tip of the knife at the base of the back of the black dog's head.

Stab it in with a knife!

The howling stopped abruptly.

The body of the fanged black dog twitched violently several times and became completely motionless.

It took no more than five seconds from the moment the black dog attacked until he was completely killed.

Chen Feng pulled out his chopping knife and shook off the blood on the knife.

Breathing is steady, heartbeat is normal, just like a normal person.

During this period of time, he was training every day in the Daxu World, and the number of bugs he killed was probably as high as a hill.

He has adapted to this kind of high-intensity fighting.

Don't talk about anything else, just talking about the psychological quality during fighting is already far beyond ordinary people.

At this time.

Just moments after the battle ended.

A once-familiar feeling welled up in my heart again.

A flood of images and feelings exploded in my mind.

Every battle in the past ten days, every sword shot, every dodge, were all dismantled into clear fragments and played back at high speed in the mind.
